Name: Qiang Hu 胡强
Title/Position: Chair  Professor  and  Head,  Department  of  Engineering  Biology,  Faculty  of  Synthetic
Affiliation: Biology, Shenzhen University of Advanced Technology (SUAT) (Shenzhen, China)
Biography: Dr. Qiang Hu is a Chair Professor and Head of Department of Engineering Biology, Faculty of  Synthetic Biology, Shenzhen University of Advanced Technology, Shenzhen, China. He also is  an  Adjunct  Professor  in  the  Institute  of  Synthetic  Biology,  Shenzhen  Institutes  of Advanced  Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences. Prior to these positions, Dr. Hu was Professor and  co-Director of the Laboratory for Algae Research and Biotechnology and co-Director of the  Arizona Center for Algae Technology and Innovation at Arizona State University. He has over  40 years of experience in fundamental and applied research on algae on topics ranging from  photosynthesis,  biosynthesis  of  lipids  and  carotenoids,  growth  physiology  of  high-density  algal   culture,   photobioreactor   system   design,   and   applications   of   algal   mass   culture  technology  for  biofuels  and  chemicals,  and  for  environmental  bioremediation.  He  was  the  President (2021-2024) and outgoing President (2025-2027) of International Society for Applied  Phycology.  Currently,  he  is  an  Associate  Editor  of  Algae  and  an  editorial  board  member  of  Journal of Applied Phycology, Applied Phycology and Phycology.

Name: Miguel Pombo
Title/Position: Founder - Azores Life Science / Ignae (Azores, Portugal)
Biography: Having graduated from Nova University in Lisbon, Miguel has worked in public and regulatory  affairs for international clients in the fields of food, cosmetics, pharma, communications and  airline companies. He founded Azores Life Science in 2012, the parent company of Ignae, a  skincare brand available in  many  prestigious retailers  around  the world.  Azores  Life  Science  uses AI and genomics to identify extremophilic microorganisms from Azores Islands and their  application in pharma, food, cosmetics and industrial processes.

This  is  more  than  a  strong  belief;  it  is  also  an  exciting  business  model.

Name: James Chang

Name: Yu Rencheng 于仁成
Title/Position: Professor - Institute  of  Oceanology,  Chinese  Academy  of  Sciences  (IOCAS)  (Qingdao,
Biography: Yu  Rencheng is  a  researcher  at  the  Institute  of  Oceanology,  Chinese  Academy  of  Sciences  (IOCAS), and currently serves as a distinguished researcher at CAS, as well as a Professor at the  University  of  Chinese  Academy  of  Sciences.  He  also  holds  important  roles  in  the  EASTHAB  Scientific  Advisory  Committee,  WESTPAC  Harmful  Algal  Blooms  Working  Group,  Water  Environment Division of the Chinese Society of Oceanology and Limnology, and the Chinese  Society of Oceanology.    His main research areas include the processes and mechanisms of coastal ecosystem evolution,  methods for analyzing and detecting toxic and harmful algae and algal toxins, ecological and  oceanographic mechanisms behind the formation and evolution of harmful algal blooms, as  well as the harmful effects of these blooms and ecological safety studies.    In the past five years, he has led more than 10 national-level projects and published over 200  papers in academic journals domestically and internationally. He has also contributed to the  compilation of several monographs. On the international collaboration front, he participated  in  the  establishment  of  the  China-Portugal  STARLab  and  the  Sino-Portugal  Joint  Lab  for  Marine   and   Environmental   Sciences,   through   which   he   developed   solid   cooperative  relationships  with  renowned  research  institutions  in  countries such  as  Portugal,  France,  and  Australia.

Name: Wen-Jun Li 李文均
Title/Position: Distinguished Professor, School of Life Sciences - Sun Yat-Sen University (Guangzhou,
Biography: Wen-Jun  Li  received  his  PhD  in  Microbiology  from  Shenyang  Institute  of  Applied  Ecology,  Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2002. He is currently working as Distinguished Professor in  School of Life Sciences, Sun Yat-Sen University, Guangzhou, China. His publications include 10  monographs,   30   authorized   patents,   and   more   than   700   peer   reviewed   papers  (https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Wen-Jun-Li)  as  the  first or  corresponding authors.  His  research mainly focuses on microbial diversity under those unusual environments (including  marine, salt lake, desert and hot spring ecosystems) by using culture-dependent and culture- independent  methods,  and  also  on  microbial  ecology  and  evolution.  He  was  awarded  the  WFCC (The World Federation for Culture Collections) Skerman award for microbial taxonomy,  and  other  10  leading  awards  for  his  outstanding  research  contributions  on  the  field  of  microbial systematics and microbial ecology.    He is serving as editorial board members or Associate Editors of more than 10 International  journals, and he was appointed as membership of International Committee on Systematics of  Prokaryotes (ICSP) since 2017, and President of Bergey’s International Society for Microbial  Systematics (BISMiS, https://www.bismis.net/bismislive.html) since December of 2023.

Name: Wei Yu 俞威
Title/Position: CEO and Founder - Xiaozao Tech/Lyxia 小藻科技(安吉)有限公司 (Shenzhen, China)
Biography: Wei Yu is the founder of Lyxia/Xiaozao Tech, a biotechnology company he established in 2012.  For  the  past  12  years,  Wei  has  dedicated  his  career  to  advancing  microalgae-based  technologies. He holds a Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering from UCLA and a Bachelor’s degree  in Biomedical Engineering from Zhejiang University.    Xiaozao Tech specializes in the innovation, cultivation, and processing of microalgae-derived  specialty  ingredients.  Utilising  its  proprietary  Phototrophic  cellular  platform,  the  company  harnesses the potential of Nannochloropsis- a single-cell green algae - to produce high-value  bioactive  components  on  a  commercial  scale.  These  components  include  polar  lipids,  EPA  (eicosapentaenoic  acid),  polysaccharides,  proteins/peptides,  and  more,  offering  sustainable  and innovative solutions for various industries.

Name: Helena Abreu
Title/Position: President - International Seaweed Association (Aveiro, Portugal)
Biography: Helena  Abreu  is  a  marine biologist  with  over  20  years  of  expertise  in  seaweed,  integrating  scientific  research,  entrepreneurship,  and  sustainability.  Her  career  began  in  the  Azores,  focusing on taxonomy and ecology, but a passion for seaweed aquaculture led her to explore  Integrated  Multi-Trophic  Aquaculture  (IMTA).  During  her  Ph.D.  and  research  career  across  Portugal, the USA, Chile, and Ireland, she developed expertise in seaweed cultivation systems,  species diversity, and biomass applications.    In 2011, Helena co-founded ALGAplus, pioneering organic-certified IMTA seaweed farming in  Europe.  Under  her  leadership,  the  company  became  a  market  leader,  securing  funding,  expanding market networks, and driving industry awareness. After leaving ALGAplus in early  2024,   she   transitioned   to independent   consulting,   advising   on   innovation,   business  development, and international collaborations in the seaweed sector.    Beyond her consulting work, Helena contributes to global seaweed initiatives as President of  the  International  Seaweed Association  (ISA,  2023-2025)  and  Strategic  Advisor  to  the  Global  Seaweed  Coalition.  She  actively  fosters  knowledge  exchange,  industry  collaboration,  and  sustainable development in alignment with global sustainability goals.    A  strong  advocate  for  community  impact, Helena  has  supervised  over  30  graduate  and  postgraduate   students,   published   extensively   on   seaweed   ecology,   cultivation,   and  applications,  and  is  a  sought-after  speaker  at  international  conferences.  Her  mission  is  to  advance sustainable marine resource management, connect stakeholders across the seaweed  value chain, and ensure that marine resources are valued and utilized responsibly for future  generations.    https://www.linkedin.com/in/helena-abreu-seaweed   https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7630-3185

Name: Jorge Dias
Title/Position: Co-founder and CEO - SPAROS Lda. (Olhão, Portugal)
Biography: Jorge  Dias  is  the  Co-founder  and  CEO  of  SPAROS  LDA (www.sparos.pt),  a  science  and  technology driven company dedicated to the development and testing of new products and  tailored  nutritional  solutions  for  the  aquaculture  market.  He  holds  a  PhD  in  Biomedical  Sciences (specialty Nutrition) by the University of Bordeaux I (France) and University of Porto  (Portugal), and an MSc in Food Technology by the University of Bordeaux I (France). Prior to  founding SPAROS, he was  a  scientist at DSM Nutritional  Products.  He has  authored 4  book  chapters and more than 100 peer-review papers on the topic of fish nutrition. His expertise  covers  the  areas  of  nutritional  requirements  of  fish  and  shrimp;  feed  formulation;  extrusion  technology;  and  the  practical  development  of  additives  and  functional  raw  materials  in  aquaculture feeds.

Name: Shi Yanxi 时彦祎
Title/Position: Founder - Zhuhai Biori Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (Zhuhai, China)
Biography: Mr. Shi Yanxi is the founder of Zhuhai Biori Biotechnology Co., Ltd. Focusing on the upstream  core  raw  materials  sector  of  bio-manufacturing,  Zhuhai  Biori    Biotechnology  Co.,  Ltd.  is  a  national  high-tech  enterprise,  a  specialized,  refined,  unique,  and  innovative  ""little  giant""  enterprise,  and  the  Guangdong  Molecular  Diagnostic  Enzyme  Engineering  Technology  Research  Center.  Biori  Biotech  has  established  several  technological  platforms  including  enzyme   evolution   and   screening,   aptamer   screening,   antibody   development,   gene  engineering   expression,   protein   process   development,   and   raw   material   application  development. In the fields of fluorescence quantitative PCR, isothermal amplification, freeze- dried  reagents  for  molecular  diagnostics,  it  has  launched  a  full  range  of  high-performance  enzyme  raw  materials  and  premix  products  that  can  provide  comprehensive  technical  solutions   for   molecular   diagnostic   reagent   manufacturers. Name: Pedro Rodrigues
Title/Position: Vice-Dean  for  Lifelong  Learning  and  Partnerships  of  the  Faculty  of  Biotechnology -
Biography: Pedro Miguel Rodrigues (B.Sc., M.Sc., and Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering) is a Professor and  the  Vice-Dean  for  Lifelong  Learning  and  Partnerships  of  the  Faculty  of  Biotechnology -  Universidade Católica Portuguesa (ESB-UCP). He is also an integrated member of the Centre  for  Biotechnology  and  Fine  Chemistry  of  UCP  (CBQF-UCP),  Porto,  Portugal.  He  is  the  coordinator of the postgraduate course in Data Science in Biotechnology and Co-coordinator  of the Bioengineering degree at ESB-UCP. He is responsible for Curricular Units of signal and  image processing, computer programming, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. He has  published  more  than  90  articles  in  international  peer-reviewed  scientific  journals,  book  chapters, and conference articles on the interface between Artificial Intelligence and Medicine.   He holds a technological patent that analyzes EEG signals via AI algorithms for asymptomatic  or early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease. His research areas focus on digital signal processing  and artificial intelligence applied to diagnose neurodegenerative, cardiac, and speech diseases  and on the development of biosensors, electronic instrumentation tools, microcontrollers, and  smart tools for fast controlling and monitoring sustainable living cities & spaces and agri-food  & biological/biomedical systems.

Name: André Antunes
Title/Position: Acting Dean of Institute of Science and Environment - University of Saint Joseph (Macau,
Biography: André  Antunes  is  an  Associate  Professor  at  Institute  of  Science  and  Environment  of  the  University  of  Saint  Joseph.  He  is  an  expert  in  microbiology  of  marine  and  extreme  environments, having specialized in deep-sea and high salinity locations.    He  has  done  his  undergraduate  studies  in  Biology  at  the  University  of  Coimbra  (Portugal),  followed with a PhD in Biochemistry (Microbiology) at the same institution but with his PhD  research   work   being   conducted   at   the   prestigious   Lehrstuhl   für   Mikrobiologie   und  Archaeenzentrum of the University of Regensburg (Germany). His research career has included  periods  of  work  in  several  countries  in  Europe,  as  well  as  in  Africa,  and  in  the  Middle  East.  Before  his  current appointment  he had  previous faculty  positions in  Cabo  Verde,  in  the UK,  and at the State Key Laboratory of Lunar and Planetary Sciences at Macau University of Science  and Technology (MUST), where he was the leader of the Astrobiology Research Group and the  coordinator of the Astrobiology and Cosmochemistry Experimental Platforms.    He has  extensive  experience with  international collaborations,  having participated as PI  and  team member of several research projects across the globe and having joined and lead several  research expeditions and cruises. As part of these, he previously worked as project manager,  being  involved  in  the  national  and  European  coordination  of  the  ESFRI  EU-funded  project  MIRRI (Microbial Resource Research Infrastructure), as well as being involved with the ESFRI  EU-funded  project  RItrain  (Reseach  Infrastructures  Training  Programme).  He  also  acted  as  consultant  and  invited  committee  member  for  NASA,  ESA,  and  the  European  Science  Foundation. Furthermore, he is an elected member of the Communications Committee of the  Microbiology   Society,   Chair   of   the   Ocean   Sustainability   Advisory   Group   and   Global  Ambassador  for  Applied  Microbiology  International,  and  editorial  member  for  a  variety  of  leading journals in his field.    Selected research highlights:   i) New species and higher-ranked taxa: two new orders, one possible new phylum;  ii)  Novel  characteristics  relevant  for  biotechnology  and  cellular  physiology:  New  cellular  contractility  cycle;  first  Halobacteria  preferring  anaerobiosis;  first  prokaryotes  accumulating  glycerol;  iii) -Omics based analysis: first genomics and proteomics studies in deep-sea brines;  iv)   Bioprospection:   New   strains   with   cytotoxic   and   apoptotic   activity;   in   silico-based  exploration for biosynthetic gene clusters; studies in biogenic carbonate production.  v) New computer-based and experimental tools: Portal for microbial knowledge exploration;  data  analysis  tool  for  microbial  genomes;  database  on  halophilic  archaea,  as  well  as  an  innovative microbial isolation technique).

Name: Maria Manuela Estevez Pintado
Title/Position: Head  of  CBQF – Centre  of  Biotechnology  and  Fine  Chemistry – Universidade  Católica
Biography: Maria  Manuela  Estevez  Pintado  is  a  Professor  of  the  College  of  Biotechnology  of  the  Portuguese  Catholic  University  (ESB-UCP)  since  2005.  In  2017,  she  became  the  director  of  CBQF (Chemistry and Biotechnology Center – State Associate Laboratory), a ESB UCP research  unit  as  well  as  Associate  Director  of  ESB  UCP.  She  was  a  member  of  the  Research  and  Internationalization  Group  of UCP  (2014-2016).  She  has  established  strong  interaction  with  industry and she has been Coordinator of Department of Scientific Services for Industry (SETIF)  (2013-2016). Additionally, she has been an invited professor at Paraíba Federal University (2012  and from 2014 to 2016).    She has a B.Sc. in Pharmacy from the Faculty of Pharmacy of the University of Porto (1991) and  finished  her Ph.D.  in Biotechnology  (in the  field of  Food Science and Engineering)  from the  Portuguese Catholic University in 1999. In the same year (until 2002) she obtained a Post-doc  research  position.  She  coordinated  the  Task  Force  of  Dairy  Products  of  the  College  of  Biotechnology Industry Association (AESBUC; 2000-2005).    Her research interests include Biotechnology and Biochemistry - carry out research in a range  of    key    technologies    for    the    production,    characterization,    and    preservation    of  industrially/traditionally processed products. The research can be summarized into:   (i) development  and  compositional  characterization  and  validation  of  bioactivity  of  functional  ingredients  (proteins  and  biopeptides,  antioxidants,  probiotics,  prebiotics  and  antimicrobials) and study applications on the development of novel functional foods   (ii) by-product  upgrading  through  bioprocesses  and  extraction  processes  aiming  to  obtain high-added value products   (iii) microbiology  and  biochemistry  in  food  field,  including  key  technologies  for  the  production, characterization, and safety issues of products and   (iv) application of the above research developments to other Biotechnological fields.

Name: Débora Campos
Title/Position: Founder & CEO - AgroGrIN Tech (Porto, Portugal)
Biography: Doctor Debora holds her PhD in Biotechnology and Food Science, from Portuguese Catholic  University  (UCP),  with  over  12  years  of  experience  in  biotechnology  R&D  at  green  and  sustainable  technologies.
